ambient_events: The Robo Teller's servos whir as it rotates a precise eleven degrees to face the next nobody.
A woman at the far ATM counts a withdrawal twice, folds it small, and puts it somewhere unpleasant.
The floor guard's coat shifts. Something under it shifts with a different weight.
Footsteps come back off the marble twice: once for you, once a half-second late.
The camera in the cornice tracks a slow arc across the hall and settles, briefly, on you.
A cleaning drone works a single square metre of floor to a mirror shine and moves on to the next.
Somewhere behind the wall, machinery that isn't an elevator moves something heavy.
The air handling comes on with a sigh. It smells of stone dust and money that has been counted many times.
description: The banking hall takes the whole height of the building: cream marble walls between reeded piers, up to a coffered ceiling with a gilt sunburst in every coffer. Three tall windows in bronze frames face Marrow Street, and the terrazzo floor has the Compound crest set into it in brass. Two cash terminals stand in alcoves in the west wall, their orange fascias the only bright colour in the room. At the south end a chest-high machine of enamel and brushed steel swivels behind a marble counter with no gap in it, and a guard in a charcoal coat stands beside the armoured door behind that. There are no chairs.

window.description: Three windows four storeys tall in bronze frames, with Marrow Street going past the bottom of them. The glass is thick enough that the street makes no sound.
window.name: the tall windows

name: Coldwater Financial — The Marble Hall
